description: This file contains a comprehensive suite of unit tests for the SCIM v2 management endpoints within the litellm proxy module. It tests functions such as create_user, update_user, patch_user, get_service_provider_config, update_group, create_group, and patch_group. The tests cover scenarios including user and group creation, updates, handling non-existent entities, role assignment, metadata serialization issues, and race condition handling during group updates. Mocks are extensively used to simulate database interactions, external dependencies, and to verify correct behavior of the functions under various edge cases and typical usage.
